action_items: Move cardboard boxes away from the sump pit.
Hook up the backup utility pump if water levels rise to the secondary mark.
bullets: Current status: Sump pump hums roughly every 20 minutes while basin water remains near the top rim.
Previous troubleshooting: Float switch was cleared and power was reset yesterday afternoon without resolving the issue.
Vendor contact: Apex Plumbing was contacted at 9:00 AM; technician Dave is slated to call back prior to noon with an arrival window.
Unconfirmed root cause: The failure could be due to either a burned-out motor or a dedicated outlet problem.
proposed_output.narrative: The basement sump pump is currently emitting a high-pitched hum every twenty minutes with standing water near the rim of the basin, persisting even after an attempt yesterday to reset the float switch and power. Dave from Apex Plumbing is expected to call back before noon regarding an arrival window, though whether the underlying failure stems from a burned-out motor or an electrical fault in the dedicated outlet has yet to be diagnosed.

candidate.source_input: basement sump pump keeps making a high pitched humming noise every 20 mins or so, basin has water sitting near the top rim. tried clearing the float switch yesterday afternoon and unplugged/replugged it, but it still didn't kick on. called Apex Plumbing at 9am, dispatcher said technician Dave will call back before noon with an arrival window. need to clear the cardboard boxes away from the pit first thing, then hook up the backup utility pump if the water reaches the secondary mark. not sure if the motor is burned out or if there's an electrical issue with the dedicated outlet, need Dave to test both.
